title: Crane Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-OO.413TH CSB.0413 AQ HQ     RCO-AK WAINWRIG
detail_text: This serves as the presolicitation notice stated in FAR 12.201(c)(2). The Government does intend to solicate orally from suppiers directly in the Alaska region. 40T All Terrain Crane with operator & rigging is required in Delta Jct off Wills Range Rd Fort Greely, Alaska 15 April 2026 & 28 April 2026. Crane & operator should plan on being on the job site from 0800 - 1800 on both days. The crane will be used to pick equipment at the Ft Greely ISB.
